# SiteVue AI Raises $7.5M in Seed Funding

[![FinSMEs](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/9693e37a896f29b3764ec27c2e558735?s=96&d=mm&r=g)](https://www.finsmes.com/author/admin "FinSMEs")

**[SiteVue AI](https://www.sitevue.ai/)**, a Nashville, Tennessee-based provider of AI-powered video cameras and video analytics for manufacturing operations, raised $7.5M in Seed financing.

The round was co-led by Penny Jar Capital and Overture with participation from Silence, Spring Bank, Mana Ventures, Outset Capital, WaterStone, and Untapped Ventures.

The company intends to use the funds to expand its operations and development efforts.

Led by Founder and CEO Andrew Jebasingh, SiteVue AI designs proprietary fixed-mounted and wearable cameras paired with AI-powered video analytics that turns production operations into visible, actionable data. Their platform custom-trains models to actively analyze camera footage in real time for process challenges, cycle times, product defects, machine health, labor time, labor movement, machine movement, mispacks, mislabels, near-misses, injuries, and PPE compliance, presenting performance data on a customized dashboard with simulation capabilities.

They currently serve customers across the US, initially focusing on automotive manufacturing and food production before expanding into retail, construction, chemical, oil, and gas industries.
